gaps.explanation: pp4-5 Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balance - Governmental Funds prints four fund columns: General 1,006,177, Debt Service 427,122, Special Revenue Fund-Street 151,832 and Special Revenue Fund-Keno 42,967 (Total Revenues 1,628,098). The Keno column has no schedule of its own, so none of its lines are in detail[]; detail revenue = 1,006,177 + 427,122 + 151,832 = 1,585,131. Keno column non-zero revenue rows (p4): Keno income 42,500 and Interest income 467 (= 42,967). 1,585,131 + 42,500 + 467 = 1,628,098 = statement.
